title: MineRakshak AI — 12-Feature Provenance & Sensor Boundary Audit
disclaimer: This document provides the definitive, machine-readable provenance classification for all 12 raw features supplied to the frozen HistGradientBoostingClassifier. Compatibility defaults are strictly identified and carry explicit warnings that they are NOT physical 2D LiDAR measurements.

features.physical_meaning: Euclidean distance from front sensor origin to nearest cluster return in horizontal scan plane

features.source: 2D polar-to-Cartesian transformation with calibrated mounting offsets
features.physical_meaning: Longitudinal distance along haul truck travel centerline ahead of front bumper

features.source: 2D polar-to-Cartesian transformation with calibrated mounting offsets
features.physical_meaning: Lateral displacement relative to haul truck centerline (+Y = left, -Y = right)
Vertical elevation above/below sensor mount plane (physically nonexistent in single-plane 2D LiDAR)
features.disclaimer: This value is NOT a physical 2D LiDAR measurement. Elevation is physically unavailable from single-plane 2D LiDAR.

features.physical_meaning: Apparent visible cross-sectional width of obstacle in scan plane
features.disclaimer: Derived from 2D planar cluster returns; represents visible cross-section width.

features.physical_meaning: Vertical object height (physically unmeasurable by single 2D plane)
features.disclaimer: This value is NOT a physical 2D LiDAR measurement. Vertical extent is physically unavailable from single-plane 2D LiDAR.

features.source: Line-of-sight radial depth variation across cluster
features.physical_meaning: Radial depth span along cluster line-of-sight in scan plane
features.disclaimer: Derived from 2D planar cluster returns; trailing surfaces are occluded.

features.physical_meaning: Number of 2D laser beams intercepting the obstacle cross-section
features.disclaimer: Direct physical 2D LiDAR return beam count.

features.formula: (distance_t - distance_{t-1}) / delta_t with exponential smoothing alpha=0.7
features.physical_meaning: Radial range rate of change (< 0 = approaching closing velocity, > 0 = receding)
features.disclaimer: Derived from multi-scan temporal tracking across >= 2 cycles. A single 2D scan cannot measure velocity.

features.source: Haul truck CAN bus / wheel speed odometry / GNSS
features.formula: Direct vehicle powertrain telemetry reading (fallback 25.0 km/h if absent)
features.physical_meaning: Forward longitudinal ground speed of haul truck
features.disclaimer: External vehicle telemetry input; not measured by LiDAR sensor.

features.source: Kinematic derivation from 2D distance and closing velocity
features.physical_meaning: Projected seconds until collision assuming constant closing velocity
features.disclaimer: Kinematically derived from 2D distance and multi-scan tracking velocity.

features.source: Neutral contract baseline (or external vision/camera fusion)
features.physical_meaning: Semantic obstacle classification (car, truck, person, crane, excavator)
features.disclaimer: This value is NOT a physical 2D LiDAR measurement. Semantic classification is unmeasurable from single-slice 2D planar contours.
